  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---

  // camera

--- source ---
  shape(scale, phase) {
    // Two mutually-exclusive guards on the same arg -- an if/else written as
    // a complementary pair (else/else-if exist too; kept explicit here so each
    // branch reads as its own self-contained block): big -> quad, small -> tri.
    if(scale > 1) {
      glColor3f(1, 0.35, 0.2);
      glBegin(GL_QUADS);
        glNormal3f(0, 0, 1);
        glVertex3f(-0.7*scale, -0.7*scale, 0);
        glVertex3f(0.7*scale, -0.7*scale, 0);
        glVertex3f(0.7*scale, 0.7*scale, 0);
        glVertex3f(-0.7*scale, 0.7*scale, 0);
      glEnd();
    }
    if(scale <= 1) {
      glColor3f(0.15, 0.55, 1);
      glBegin(GL_TRIANGLES);
        glNormal3f(0, 0, 1);
        glVertex3f(cos(phase)*0.9*scale, sin(phase)*0.9*scale, 0);
        glVertex3f(cos(phase+TAU/3)*0.9*scale, sin(phase+TAU/3)*0.9*scale, 0);
        glVertex3f(cos(phase+2*TAU/3)*0.9*scale, sin(phase+2*TAU/3)*0.9*scale, 0);
      glEnd();
    }
  }
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, GL_TRUE);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 30);

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(-2.2, 0, 0);
    shape(0.9, t);
  glPopMatrix();
  glPushMatrix();
    shape(1.4, t*0.5);
  glPopMatrix();
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(2.2, 0, 0);
    shape(0.65, -t*0.8);
  glPopMatrix();
